usage: Department store lobby, supermarket and bakery interior backgrounds. Interactive props remain HTML/SVG; existing Nickson character reused. Original generated PNGs preserved, WebP quality88 used by game and offline pack.

images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Panda School department store game interior background, landscape 1536x1024. Primary request: A cozy small department store atrium lobby. Two inviting shop entrances open into the scene: a supermarket with baskets and colorful food shelves, and a bakery with bread displays. Simple basket and loaf pictograms above the entrances. Rounded wooden information desk, cushioned bench, potted plants, sunny tall windows. Wide clear central walkway. Style: gentle richly detailed hand-painted watercolor children's storybook, warm cream paper texture, pale teal, honey-colored wood, sage green and soft peach. Eye-level wide room perspective, rounded inviting furniture, calm edges, comfortably clear middle area reserved for separately rendered game controls. Full illustrated scene, not a UI mockup. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brands, no logos or watermark, no people or foreground characters (existing Nickson cutout is added separately). No flames, sharp blades, hot exposed equipment, scary elements, advertising, payment card details or real currency.
images.source: Built-in image_gen; original generated PNG preserved in this repository.
